newsitem.title: CHINA: HKMA's Yam says no need for concern on HK dollar.
newsitem.headline: HKMA's Yam says no need for concern on HK dollar.

text.p: Hong Kong Monetary Authority chief executive Joseph Yam on Friday dismissed concerns about an attack on the Hong Kong dollar.
Asked by reporters in Shanghai if he was worried about speculators attacking the Hong Kong dollar, Yam said: "No."
Yam, attending an annual meeting of governors of 11 regional central banks and monetary authorities, declined to comment further.
The Hong Kong dollar calmed down in trading on Friday, but tensions lingered after forwards shot up on Thursday, sparking fears of a speculative attack on Asia's most strongly pegged currency.
